findings.issue: 何 before 言おう is read なに, not なん (なん only before だ/て/と/counters, e.g. なんだ, なんで). 何(を)言おうとした = なにいおうとした. The kana teaches a wrong reading.
findings.current: あれ、わたしなんいおうとしたんだっけ?
findings.suggested: あれ、わたしなにいおうとしたんだっけ?

findings.issue: Reading of 何 wrong in context: before the verb 言おう it is なに (as in 何言ってるの = なにいってるの), not なん.

Three errors: 君を is the object of 捕まえる, not a topic ('As for you' is wrong); 捕まえ means 'catch/arrest', not 'fetch (it)'; and のではない is a clause negation, but 'isn't that right' renders it as an agreement tag, flipping the denial into an affirmation.
findings.current: As for you, to fetch (it), I came, isn't that right, you see.
findings.suggested: You (obj.), to catch, (I) came — it is not (that), you know.

findings.issue: 'Quanto a você' misreads the object marker を as topic (the item's own expl says 君 is the object); and 'vim, não é (assim), viu' reads as a tag question ('né?'), while のではない negates the whole clause ('não é que eu tenha vindo...').
findings.current: Quanto a você, em direção a pegar, vim, não é (assim), viu.
findings.suggested: Você (obj.), para capturar, vim — não é (o caso disso), viu.

findings.issue: tokens[0] フランス and tokens[1] 語 are spurious duplicates placed BEFORE もしかして; フランス語 already appears correctly as a single token later. Concatenated tokens yield フランス語もしかしてフランス語できたりする, so the dissection no longer reconstructs the sentence.
findings.current: tokens[0]=フランス(ふらんす), tokens[1]=語(ご) at head of list
findings.suggested: Delete tokens[0] and tokens[1]; keep only the single フランス語 token after もしかして.

findings.issue: Derived from the wrong kana なんいおう: correct reading is なにいおう, so the romaji needs nani + iou (double i). Current 'naniou' drops a syllable of 言おう.
